title: Species-Specific Fruit Handling Strategies of Frugivorous Birds on Fruiting Plants and Their Ecological Role in Seed Dispersal in Guru Ghasidas Vishwyavidyalaya, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh
content: Frugivorous birds play a major role in seed dispersal, help in forest regeneration, maintaining species diversity and contribute to the ecosystem. They are commonly found in forest, gardens, local and urban areas. They usually feed on fruits, figs, and berries, helping plants to spread across a large area. By spreading seed, these birds help the forest to grow and stay healthy. This present paper is an attempt to study the feeding behaviour and develop an idea about the frugivorous bird species of Guru Ghasidas Vishwayavidyala and their relationship between the fruiting plants inside the campus of Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya. The type of plants they choose, on the basis of tree and shrubs, fruiting or flowering plants, ripen or unripen fruit, choosing pulp or the whole fruit, choosing on the basis of colour, shape and size is represented the needs and interest of the birds and their relationship with the plants.
